APIs for preparing, querying, and verifying funk transactions.

# Purpose
This header defines the transaction interface for `funk`, including the `fd_funk_txn_t` data structure, state values, index helpers, and inline accessors for parent, child, and sibling links. It also declares the main transaction operation [`fd_funk_txn_prepare`](<#fd_funk_txn_prepare>) and the verification function [`fd_funk_txn_verify`](<#fd_funk_txn_verify>), which are used to create and check in-preparation transaction trees. The file includes pool and map template instantiations for transaction lookup by transaction ID, and it uses a read-write lock in each transaction record for synchronization. It is meant to be included through `fd_funk.h`, and it documents that transaction-level operations are not thread-safe without external locking.
